author: DaiqingChen
body:
@DaiqingChen performed QC of annotationa of all laminin trimers, need to remove the gene products of following laminin trimers:

- [ ] Laminin-121 trimer: remove LAMA3 [Q16787], LAMB4 [B7ZMJ6][A4D0S4] from human; remove Lama3 [Q61789] from mouse
- [ ] Laminin-211 trimer: remove LAMC2[Q13753] from human; remove lamc2 [Q61092][G5E874] from mouse
- [ ] Laminin-332 trimer: remove LAMA5[O15230] from human; remove Lama5[Q61001] from mouse

UniProt IDs in this request are obtained from the QuickGO annotation of each Laminin trimer on 2026/02/02.  List as attached: [260202_Laminin annotation QC.xlsx](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25029227/260202_Laminin.annotation.QC.xlsx)
